t01.name: Broker
t01.description: A reserved, smiling broker offers one token while hiding more tokens in a pocket.

t02.name: Opportunist
t02.description: An opportunist steps through an opening in a boundary and takes a resource token.

t03.name: Smiler
t03.description: A smiling figure offers a friendly gesture while quietly keeping a separate account.

t04.name: Pursuer
t04.description: A pursuer crosses a stop boundary while following a trail with a magnifying glass.

t05.name: Harvester
t05.description: A harvester twists a wage bag with both hands, squeezing out coins.

t06.name: Raider
t06.description: A raider carries away a resource chest with a broken seal and crosses a boundary.

t07.name: Collector
t07.description: A collector holds official papers while taking the last savings jar from an empty cabinet.

t08.name: Bruiser
t08.description: A bruiser holds a money bag while kicking over a small stall.

t09.name: Puppet Master
t09.description: A puppet master holds a crossbar and adjusts one of three control strings.

t10.name: Agitator
t10.description: An agitator speaks through a megaphone, sending sharp sound waves in both directions.

t11.name: Power Broker
t11.description: A power broker holds a red zero score above and a green ten score below.

t12.name: Cult Leader
t12.description: A smiling leader in round glasses offers a welcoming hand while hiding a short chain behind the body.

t13.name: Enforcer
t13.description: An enforcer with eyes hidden by a low cap closes handcuffs, with keys at the waist.

t14.name: Decider
t14.description: A decider stamps one decision while sweeping other papers aside.

t15.name: Arbiter
t15.description: A masked arbiter tears a blank sheet of paper in two.

t16.name: Tyrant
t16.description: A calm tyrant in a laurel crown sits on a throne and presses its single large button.
